quirks: Input is a query parameter (?domain=), not a JSON body — it is a GET. Pass the bare name or name.tld (e.g. 'mybrand' or 'mybrand.com').
Service checks a fixed set of common TLDs (.com .net .org .io .co .dev .app .ai .xyz .me) regardless of TLD supplied; read body.available_tlds / body.taken_tlds for the summary.
qa-pay reported confirmed:false / txHash:null but status 200 with full payload — settlement is async on Base; the call succeeded.
usage.guide: Call GET https://netintel-production-440c.up.railway.app/domain-availability/check with a ?domain= query param holding the brand name (e.g. ?domain=mybrand). Pays $0.002 USDC on Base via x402, returns 200 JSON synchronously. Read body.results[] for per-TLD availability (domain, available, status, registrar, expires_at), or use body.available_tlds[] / body.taken_tlds[] for quick summaries, and body.score / body.grade for an overall brandability rating.
